title: Hungarian language-area revision in Romania
publisher: ISPMN / Institutul pentru Studierea Problemelor Minorităților Naționale
dataOrigin: Romanian National Institute of Statistics, RPL 2021 table 2.03.2
method: Administrative units with more than 50% Hungarian mother tongue among respondents whose mother tongue is known (ISPMN lmbRelHu, INS RPL 2021 table 2.03.2). This is a transparent cartographic selection, not a boundary of all Hungarian speakers. Missing responses are excluded by the source percentage. Minority communities below this threshold are not asserted absent. The main Székely component is separate from smaller western border communities.
denominator: Respondents with known mother tongue, matching ISPMN lmbRelHu
sourceLicense: No explicit dataset license stated on the map page; source attribution retained. This supplement is not represented as part of the Glottography CC BY 4.0 data.
